scope: Actual pinned RANGE64 and ARANGE64 all-slot recursion

verification.regression: Native traversal previously failed on missing pivot fields. Four/eight-byte internal node cases now recover both leaves around an empty internal slot without pivot/meta dependencies.

limitations: Actual pinned recursion executes with mocked typed nodes and parent pointer reads. This is not a real image or complete object validity contract.
This supersedes earlier internal pivot/meta termination limitations. Native traversal now reads all ISF slots and applies the pinned low-nibble-only slot filter.
Native duplicate/cycle handling, parent validation and result sorting retain independent behavior; complete maple traversal parity is not claimed.
The public Linux32 ISF gate remains closed and real Linux32 end-to-end acceptance is not established.
No full plugin contract is established.
